intro.description: Get the first introduction of a member from the intro channel

idByReaction.description: List the ids of everyone who reacted to a message with an emoji

idByRole.description: List the ids of every member who has a role

inviteLink.description: Get a permanent invite link for this server

mentionOption.description: Mention the members instead of listing ids (default: no)

replyMessageOption.description: Link of a message to send the list to as a reply

contentOption.description: Text to add after the list

inThisChannelOption.description: Only members who can see this channel (default: no)

channelOption.description: Channel to invite to (default: this channel)
